nodes.label: IQI Marker Parser (General + Special)
nodes.rationale: Two regex patterns (GENERAL_MARKER_PATTERN and SPECIAL_MARKER_PATTERN) handle IQI marker formatting variants: general markers use NUMBER+MATERIAL order (e.g. 10FE), special markers use MATERIAL+NUMBER order (e.g. FE10). MATERIAL_ALIASES maps common OCR confusions (E->FE, N1->NI, etc.).

nodes.label: IQI Grade Fusion
nodes.rationale: Grade computation depends on IQI type. For general markers: grade = plate_number + wire_count - 1 (range check: 1-7 wires). For special markers: grade = plate_number (single-grade, wire_count >= 1). Uses RESULT_CODE_TABLE for standardized error reporting across the pipeline.

nodes.label: IQI Grade Inference Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: The pipeline flows: image load, optional weld orientation correction, resize+windowing, full-image OCR for plate+field extraction, YOLO gauge ROI detection, perspective crop, optional CCW90 rotation if wide, ROI windowing, ROI OCR, FClip wire inference, grade fusion. Plate source selection prefers ROI OCR over full-image OCR with fallback. Visualization and debug artifacts produced at every stage.

nodes.label: Subprocess OCR Architecture
nodes.rationale: PaddleOCR runs in a separate subprocess (ocr_paddle_worker.py) to avoid CUDA/PaddlePaddle conflicts with the PyTorch-based main process. Communication is via stdin/stdout JSON lines protocol. The client (PaddleOCRSubprocessClient) manages process lifecycle and sends detect/recognize/close requests.
